newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Analysts see S-E-Banken heading for big deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Analysts see S-E-Banken heading for big deal - paper.

text.p: Swedish bank analysts expect S-E-Banken to undergo major restructuring this year, either in the form of a division or a merger, daily Dagens Industri reported on Thursday.
Eleven of 12 analysts interviewed expect to see big changes in S-E-Banken, despite repeated denials by the bank's top management, the newspaper said.
Half of the analysts interviewed expect S-E-Banken's network of nationwide branch offices to be separated from investment banking operations and sold off, the daily said.
"Since S-E-Banken's chief executive Jacob Wallenberg created partly new business areas, speculation has heated up that the branch network will be separated and sold off," the newspaper said.
Five of the analysts expect that S-E-Banken will merge with another bank. Of those, three find the long-awaited merger with Nordbanken the most likely scenario, Dagens Industri said.
